tunnelNetwork.label: Tunnel network
tunnelNetwork.tip: Address range of this VPN interface (e.g. 10.10.0.0/24) — part of the mesh's shared address space; must not overlap with other interfaces/subnets

forwarding.label: Forwarding
forwarding.tip: Allows traffic to be routed BETWEEN this VPN and the rest of the mesh (without it, this interface's clients won't see subnets/clients on other servers and providers)
